description: The agent must: (1) Install/use the akshare library and call `stock_zh_a_hist(symbol='600519', period='daily', start_date='20240101', end_date='20240329', adjust='qfq')` — the critical proprietary trap is the `adjust='qfq'` parameter (前复权); using no adjustment or 'hfq' will produce different closing prices and a wrong MA20. (2) Call `stock_financial_analysis_indicator(symbol='600519')` and extract the '净利率' column from the first row (~54.8). (3) Call `stock_board_industry_cons_em(symbol='白酒')` to get the 8 constituent stocks, count them (8), and compute the median of the '市盈率' column. (4) Compute the 20-day moving average of the '收盘' column from the qfq-adjusted DataFrame (last 20 rows), round appropriately. (5) Write all results into `analysis_report.json` with recognizable field names: ma20_close/ma20, latest_close, net_profit_margin/net_margin, sector_stock_count, sector_median_pe.
